building-west-front.subject: west end block of a grey and yellow industrial warehouse seen from the front: a tall tower bay with a DENVER FRFZ panel, hazard stripes, pipes and a ladder
building-west-front.notes: This picture is one section cut from a longer building. Draw only this section as a standalone block of the same height and proportions; where the picture is cut, close the block with a plain grey wall, adding no doors, signs or equipment to it. The top word on the panel is misspelt DOWCR in the source: write DENVER there instead, above FRFZ, in the same letters.

building-centre-front.subject: middle block of a grey and yellow industrial warehouse seen from the front: a large SAEDER-KRUPP sign with its emblem above three roller-shutter loading doors
building-centre-front.notes: This picture is one section cut from a longer building. Draw only this section as a standalone block of the same height and proportions; where the picture is cut, close the block with a plain grey wall, adding no doors, signs or equipment to it. The sign reads SAEDER-KRUPP and, below it, LOGISTICS & FABRICATION YARD, spelled exactly so.
